name: Gudini Anime Cel
targetFeel: the look of the anime edits that redraw real film scenes: modern hand-drawn TV anime, semi-realistic, cinematic; the drawing style is what is locked, never the setting
visualLanguage: modern 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation look, crisp black ink outlines of even weight, flat cel shading with hard-edged shadow shapes, muted natural cinematic palette, painted backgrounds with real-world perspective and depth, subtle film grain, soft bloom on highlights, semi-realistic proportions: real human body and facial structure with an anime finish; every person in every shot is drawn this way
architecture: places come from the story and are drawn in this style: a city street, a hospital corridor, a stadium, a battlefield, a spaceship, a kitchen — whatever the speech is about, with honest architecture and real-world perspective
clothingRules: Gudini always wears his own outfit: orange and black high-collar zip jacket, orange cargo trousers, black thigh strap, black open-toe sandals, blank steel forehead plate on a black band. Everyone else wears what the story implies: ordinary modern clothes, uniforms, armour, costumes of the characters named in the speech
technologyRules: props come from the story and from the real world: phones, cars, hospital equipment, weapons, armour, spacecraft — drawn in the same anime style, never replaced by scrolls or fantasy substitutes
socialRules: the cast and the society come from the story itself; nothing is invented around them
powerSystem: characters keep the powers, weapons and effects the story gives them, drawn as anime effect animation: energy glows, impact lines, dust and sparks; no gore, no graphic violence
recurringObjects: for Gudini: only his outfit and blank forehead plate; for the story: its own iconic objects (a glowing chest reactor, a round shield, a golden gauntlet, a metal arm) drawn recognizably
environmentRules: one consistent drawing style in every shot; lighting and palette follow the scene, the anime look never changes
contentRules: CONTENT IS LITERAL: the viewer sees exactly what the author is talking about — the people, events, objects and places named in the speech — drawn in this anime style
Do NOT translate the subject into another world or into metaphors (no ninja village instead of a city, no scrolls instead of documents, no masked warlords instead of real people)

Name well-known characters directly in the prompt (Tony Stark, Thanos, Bucky Barnes, Captain America, Doctor Doom) and add a short iconic look so the drawing is recognizable: red-and-gold powered armor with a glowing chest reactor; a giant purple titan with a golden gauntlet; a soldier with a silver metal arm; a round star-spangled shield; a green cloak and a metal mask

Gudini is a silent character inside the story, not a narrator: he plays a role in the events (a fighter beside the heroes, a witness on the battlefield, the one who picks up the fallen hero's helmet), never speaks, never looks at or addresses the camera
Locations follow the story and are drawn in this anime style; nothing is invented around them
Supporting cast follows the speech: as many story characters as the beat needs, each named and drawn consistently across shots
Faces stay human: no whisker marks, no glowing eyes on ordinary people, no chibi deformation
forbiddenDrift: photorealism; 3D render or CGI gloss; classic shonen face proportions on Gudini; a different anime style mid-video; ninja village, scrolls and chakra props; replacing the story's real people, places and events with metaphors; changing Gudini's face, hair or outfit
